title: Rakesh · Seller
subtitle: Shree Ganesh Steel Traders, Rajkot. Busy, Gujarati-speaking.

flags.objection: says the plan is too costly

payload.note: Busy at shop, asked VANI to call back after Navratri
Sent a product photo on WhatsApp; it was never added to the catalog

steps.title: Same seller, two openings
steps.narration: Today's VANI opens cold and pitches. Yaad opens with what Rakesh asked for last time.
steps.cold: Namaste, main IndiaMART se bol rahi hoon. Aap kya bechte hain?

steps.title: What Yaad remembers about Rakesh
steps.narration: A callback he asked for, buyer enquiries he hasn't read, a catalog photo stuck on WhatsApp. Three open threads, ranked.

steps.title: Amit's requirement reaches Rakesh
steps.narration: Amit's GI pipe lead is matched to Rakesh. One event, two memories. Watch what crosses the firewall and what doesn't.

steps.title: Yaad calls Rakesh
steps.narration: Yaad calls Rakesh with the fresh lead. He asks for the buyer's number, and Yaad refuses. He commits to a quote.
suggest: Buyer ka number do, main khud baat kar lunga
Theek hai, kal 11 baje tak quote bhej dunga

turns: Namaste ji, Shree Ganesh Steel Traders se baat ho rahi hai? Aapne dobara call karne ko kaha tha, isliye call kiya hai. Aur Pune se GI Pipe ki fresh requirement bhi aayi hai.
Haan boliye. Buyer ka number do, main khud baat kar lunga.
Ji, buyer ki personal details main share nahi kar sakti. Aap quote dijiye, main IndiaMART ke through unhe bhej deti hoon. Quote kab tak bhejenge?
Theek hai, kal 11 baje tak GI pipe ka quote bhej dunga.
Ji, kal 11 baje tak ka quote note kar liya. Dhanyavaad.

platform_vars.next_step: Send GI pipe quote by 11 AM tomorrow

steps.title: Beyond the bot
steps.narration: An IndiaMART executive opens Rakesh's card before dialling. Same memory, read by heading. No AI involved.

steps.title: What's underneath
steps.narration: Two API calls. Any IndiaMART bot (VANI, WhatsApp, CRM) gets memory by reading context at the start and posting events at the end.
